STORE="selectiveprep_2023_hybrid_v1";let state=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE)||'{}'),subject=null,timer=null,view='home';const app=document.getElementById('app');const S=k=>state[k]||(state[k]={answers:{},flags:{},q:1,remaining:DATA[k].minutes*60,submitted:false,result:null});const save=()=>localStorage.setItem(STORE,JSON.stringify(state));function status(k){const s=S(k);return s.submitted?'Completed':Object.keys(s.answers).length?'In progress':'Not started'}function home(){clearInterval(timer);view='home';app.innerHTML=`<div class="wrap"><div class="card"><a href="../">← All tests</a><h1>2023 Hybrid Test</h1><p class="small">Reading is a deliberate hybrid: Practice Test 1 Q1-8 & Q15-20, official 2023 Q9-14 & Q21-30. Maths and Thinking are full 2023 papers. Built from uploaded offline PDFs only.</p></div><div class="grid">${Object.keys(DATA).map(k=>`<div class="card"><h3>${DATA[k].name}</h3><div class="status">${status(k)}</div><p class="small">${DATA[k].count} questions • ${DATA[k].minutes} minutes</p><button class="primary" onclick="start('${k}')">${S(k).submitted?'View results':status(k)==='In progress'?'Resume':'Start test'}</button> ${S(k).submitted?`<button class="secondary" onclick="review('${k}')">Review</button>`:''}<div style="margin-top:12px"><button class="danger" onclick="resetSub('${k}')">Reset</button></div></div>`).join('')}</div></div>`}function start(k){subject=k;if(S(k).submitted)return results(k);view='exam';render();clearInterval(timer);timer=setInterval(()=>{let s=S(subject);if(view!=='exam'||s.submitted)return;if(s.remaining>0){s.remaining--;save();clock()}else submit(subject,true)},1000)}function clock(){let e=document.getElementById('timer');if(!e)return;let r=S(subject).remaining;e.textContent=String(Math.floor(r/60)).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(r%60).padStart(2,'0');e.className='timer'+(r<=300?' critical':r<=600?' warn':'')}function render(){let d=DATA[subject],s=S(subject),q=s.q,item=d.questions[q-1];let nums=Array.from({length:d.count},(_,i)=>i+1).map(n=>`<button class="qnum ${s.answers[n]?'answered ':''}${s.flags[n]?'flagged ':''}${n===q?'current':''}" onclick="go(${n})">${n}</button>`).join('');let choices=item.choices.map(c=>`<button class="choice ${s.answers[q]===c?'sel':''}" onclick="answer('${c}')">${c}</button>`).join('');let ctx=(item.context||[]).map(x=>`<img class="qimg" src="${ASSETS[x]}">`).join('');let qi=item.img?`<img class="qimg" src="${ASSETS[item.img]}">`:'';app.innerHTML=`<div class="top"><div class="brand">2023 Hybrid Test • ${d.name}</div><div id="timer" class="timer"></div><button class="secondary" onclick="home()">Home</button></div><div class="wrap exam"><main class="card"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center"><h2>Question ${q} of ${d.count}</h2><button class="secondary" onclick="flag()">${s.flags[q]?'★ Flagged':'☆ Flag'}</button></div>${ctx?'<div class="source-label">SOURCE TEXT / INFORMATION</div>'+ctx:''}${qi?'<div class="question-label">CURRENT QUESTION</div>'+qi:''}<div class="choices">${choices}</div><div class="nav"><button class="secondary" ${q===1?'disabled':''} onclick="go(${Math.max(1,q-1)})">Previous</button><button class="primary" onclick="go(${Math.min(d.count,q+1)})">${q===d.count?'Stay on last':'Next'}</button></div></main><aside class="card side"><b>Questions</b><div class="qgrid">${nums}</div><p class="small">Green = answered. Orange border = flagged.</p><button class="primary" style="width:100%" onclick="submit('${subject}',false)">Submit test</button></aside></div>`;clock()}function answer(c){S(subject).answers[S(subject).q]=c;save();render()}function go(n){S(subject).q=n;save();render()}function flag(){let s=S(subject);s.flags[s.q]=!s.flags[s.q];save();render()}function submit(k,forced){let d=DATA[k],s=S(k);if(!forced&&!confirm('Submit this test? Answers will be locked.'))return;let correct=0,wrong=0,unanswered=0;for(let i=1;i<=d.count;i++){let a=s.answers[i];if(!a)unanswered++;else if(a===d.key[i-1])correct++;else wrong++}s.submitted=true;s.result={correct,wrong,unanswered,total:d.count};save();clearInterval(timer);results(k)}function results(k){subject=k;let d=DATA[k],r=S(k).result;app.innerHTML=`<div class="wrap"><div class="card"><button class="secondary" onclick="home()">← Home</button><h1>${d.name} result</h1><div class="metricgrid"><div class="metric"><b>${r.correct}/${r.total}</b>Correct</div><div class="metric"><b>${r.wrong}</b>Incorrect</div><div class="metric"><b>${r.unanswered}</b>Unanswered</div><div class="metric"><b>${Math.round(r.correct/r.total*100)}%</b>Score</div></div><button class="primary" onclick="review('${k}')">Review wrong/unanswered</button></div></div>`}function review(k){subject=k;let d=DATA[k],s=S(k),items=[];for(let i=1;i<=d.count;i++)if(s.answers[i]!==d.key[i-1]){let item=d.questions[i-1],ctx=(item.context||[]).map(x=>`<img class="qimg" src="${ASSETS[x]}">`).join(''),qi=item.img?`<img class="qimg" src="${ASSETS[item.img]}">`:'';items.push(`<div class="card" style="margin-top:12px"><h3>Question ${i}</h3><p>Your answer: <b class="wrong">${s.answers[i]||'Unanswered'}</b> &nbsp; Correct: <b class="correct">${d.key[i-1]}</b></p>${ctx}${qi}</div>`)}app.innerHTML=`<div class="wrap"><button class="secondary" onclick="results('${k}')">← Result</button><h1>${d.name} review</h1>${items.join('')||'<p>No incorrect questions.</p>'}</div>`}function resetSub(k){if(!confirm('Reset all progress for this subject?'))return;delete state[k];save();home()}home();
</script></body></html>
